item.title: Johnson Controls to acquire Boston-based company to expand its data center cooling capabilities
item.description: Building technology company Johnson Controls, which is based in Ireland but has operating headquarters in Glendale, on Wednesday announced that it has reached an agreement to acquire Boston-based Alloy Enterprises. item.title: Guardian Credit Union names new CEO
item.description: Oak Creek-based Guardian Credit Union announced that Steve Heiderer has been promoted to president and chief executive officer. He previously served as senior vice president and chief operating officer. item.title: West Milwaukee Pick ‘n Save store building sold for $11 million
item.description: Fox Point-based commercial real estate firm General Capital Group has sold a Pick ‘n Save store building in West Milwaukee for $11.4 million, according to state property records. item.title: MGS opens new Richfield facility
item.description: Germantown-based manufacturer MGS has opened a 300,000-square-foot Richfield facility, creating 300 new positions.

item.title: Generac to acquire East Peoria, Illinois-based Enercon Engineering
item.description: Generac has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Enercon Engineering, a manufacturer of custom power systems and industrial enclosures.

item.title: City of Milwaukee next municipality to sue fire truck makers over alleged price fixing scheme
item.description: The City of Milwaukee has filed a class action lawsuit against major fire truck manufacturers, alleging a price-fixing scheme.
